verdict: Exploratory out-of-group backtest only. Every labelled row is predicted without its lineage group in training, but no target has an untouched external clinical cohort.

protocol.split: deterministic stratified group out-of-fold; 5 folds when >=5 groups, otherwise leave-small-group folds
protocol.preprocessing: refit inside each training fold; no test-row imputation or scaling fit
protocol.ranking: mean of per-group sensitivity and per-group specificity
protocol.uncertainty: 1000 bootstrap resamples of complete lineage groups
protocol.permutation: 20 training-label permutations for each displayed selected experiment
protocol.selection_warning: The displayed winner is selected on these same OOF results and is not an unbiased final-test estimate.
protocol.recovery: Metrics were independently recalculated from the durable complete OOF prediction ledger after terminal interruption.

targets.label: Artifact / degraded signal
targets.definition: BUT-QDB pure consensus class 1=0 and class 2/3=1, combined with NSTDB official noise-inactive=0 and noise-active=1.
targets.reliability: limited: fewer than thirty independent groups

targets.label: Ictal seizure interval
targets.definition: 1 only inside a configured original expert seizure interval; 0 outside.
targets.reliability: critical: fewer than five independent groups

targets.label: Non-normal beat
targets.definition: 0 for AAMI N and 1 for S, V, F, or Q; exact WFDB symbols remain preserved.
targets.reliability: exploratory: adequate group count, but no external clinical test set

targets.label: NSTDB noise active
targets.definition: Official NSTDB alternating electrode-motion noise schedule.
targets.reliability: critical: fewer than five independent groups

targets.label: Strict unusable signal
targets.definition: Pure BUT-QDB consensus class 1 versus class 3; class 2 is excluded.
targets.reliability: limited: fewer than thirty independent groups
